segments.title: Pre-Show Setup & Fiona Nova Raid Preview
segments.notes: Case Blackwell opens a shortened broadcast, troubleshooting technical issues and promoting Fiona Nova's 12-hour Lethal Company charity stream.

segments.title: Pope Francis Declares Sexual Pleasure a Gift from God
segments.notes: Case and Chet cover the BBC report on Pope Francis's sermon on lust, discussing Cardinal Fernandez's controversial 1990s book and conservative backlash; a Level 4 Hype Train interrupts.

segments.title: Anti-Sex Demon Studio Interview
segments.notes: Case summons an anti-sex demon who claims to have renounced copulation for knitting, but whose rhetoric veers into graphic horniness; Pepito briefly appears.

segments.title: Kentucky Bill to Decriminalize First-Cousin Sex
segments.notes: DJ Newsic delivers an R&B musical report on Kentucky HB269; Case's cousin Chase calls in from Roanoke to defend 'cousin love' including communal bathing.

segments.title: Lethal Company Transition & Raid
segments.notes: Musical send-off as Case attempts to join Fiona Nova's Lethal Company lobby; stream ends mid-connection.

episode_summary: Case Blackwell anchors a truncated news broadcast ahead of a raid on Fiona Nova's 12-hour Lethal Company stream. Coverage includes Pope Francis declaring sexual pleasure a divine gift, a studio interview with a suspiciously horny anti-sex demon, and DJ Newsic's R&B musical report on a Kentucky bill to decriminalize first-cousin sex — featuring a call-in defense from Case's own cousin Chase. The broadcast closes with a musical transition as Case attempts to join the Lethal Company lobby.
